subject: Request: OnRamp cohort self-serve credits — eligibility evidence attached
messages:
From: Kate Mitchell <kate@onrampvc.com>
To: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: applications@onrampvc.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: OnRamp cohort — request for self-serve credits and eligibility verification

Hi Logan / Ben,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow last week. We’re running our Winter OnRamp cohort (cohort start: 2026-11-15) and would like to activate the self-serve credit bundle you offer for accelerator partners. Our program manager attached the cohort roster (orv_cohort_companies.csv) and the OnRamp mandate letter (onramp_mandate.pdf) for verification.

High level ask: can Redwood verify these companies and apply the partner credits in self-serve (so founders can redeem without manual invoices)? Ideal outcome — each accepted company gets a 3-month trial extension + $1,500 platform credit (redeemable within 180 days). We’d like this live by 2026-11-12 so the founders can claim during onboarding.

Quick notes on eligibility:
- Startups included are pre-seed to Series A, primarily US-based (some remote).
- We have a public acceptance list and the attached signed mandate.

Could you confirm what evidence you need from our side (company domain verification, signed acceptance per company, etc.) and whether the self-serve issuance can be automated against the attached CSV? Happy to schedule a 20-min sync if that helps.

Attachments: orv_cohort_companies.csv (csv), onramp_mandate.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Kate Mitchell
Program Director | OnRamp VC
kate@onrampvc.com
https://onrampvc.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Mitchell <kate@onrampvc.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort — request for self-serve credits and eligibility verification

Hi Kate — thanks for the packet and the heads up.

We can support a partner self-serve issuance tied to your cohort list, but we need a couple of validation items before we can trigger the automated credits:
1) Per-company proof of cohort acceptance (a single CSV is fine if it includes primary contact email and company domain).
2) Confirmation that each company has consented to receiving Redwood promotional credits (a checkbox or signature column in the CSV works).
3) Any legal billing contacts if a zero-dollar invoice needs to be generated for audit (optional).

If those are present we can wire an issuance job via our partner credits admin (link below) and set the per-company credit amount you requested. A couple of operational details — please note them:
- Max per-company credit for self-serve partner issuance is currently $2,000. You requested $1,500 which is within policy.
- Credits expire 180 days from issuance and can be applied to hosted API usage only.
- We enforce an email-domain verification step: founder/maintainer email must match the company domain in the CSV or show an approval flag.

I’ve CC’d Priyom from Partnerships Operations so he can confirm the timing and run the issuance once you confirm the final CSV format. If you want automated redemption links for founders, we need to enable the cohort promo code in the console — Priyom can toggle that.

Self-serve admin (internal): https://console.redwoodinference.com/credits/admin/issuance?deal=ORV-1147

If you want, we can do a quick 15-min call today to walk through the CSV layout and get this queued.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kate@onrampvc.com
Date: 2026-11-06T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort — request for self-serve credits and eligibility verification

On Nov 5, 2026, Kate Mitchell wrote:
> Hi Logan / Ben,
>
> Thanks for the quick onboarding flow last week. We’re running our Winter OnRamp cohort...

Thanks — I reviewed the CSV and mandate. The file includes company, founder email, signed_consent column and company domain for 42 companies. I validated a sample of domains (10) and the consent flag is present.

I initiated the partner issuance job this morning using the partner admin flow. Summary:
- Issuance batch: ORV-2026-1147
- # companies queued: 42
- Per-company credit: $1,500 (applied as platform credit visible in console)
- Expiry: 180 days from issuance date

I attached the issuance stub (issuance_receipt_1147.pdf) for your records — this is our internal audit receipt (not a customer-facing invoice).

Operational notes:
- I enabled the cohort promo toggle so founders get a redemption link when they click the invite in the onboarding email.
- Two companies returned domain-mismatch flags; I set them to manual review and reached out to their listed founders for confirmation.
- If OnRamp needs a 1-week extension of the redemption window (so founders can claim past the 180-day default), that needs approval from Partnerships Ops (reply with the cohort reason and requested extra days).

Ben/Logan — flag if you want me to delay issuance until the manual-review items are resolved.

Attachments: issuance_receipt_1147.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
From: Kate Mitchell <kate@onrampvc.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-07T15:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort — request for self-serve credits and eligibility verification

Thanks — truly appreciate the fast turnaround.

Two quick follow-ups:
1) Please proceed with issuance for the 40 validated companies; hold the 2 with domain flags on manual review — we’ll send the proof by EOD 2026-11-08.
2) Can Redwood grant a 7-day extension to the redemption window for this cohort only (so founders onboarding on 2026-11-15 have enough time to claim their credits)? We’re asking because a few founders prefer to wait until their company domains are set up later this month.

If you can confirm both items I’ll circulate the onboarding email to founders tomorrow. Appreciate the attached issuance receipt — that covers our audit trail for the accelerator.

Best,
Kate Mitchell
Program Director | OnRamp VC
kate@onrampvc.com
